counterfactual_missing_items: no mention of other cardiac conditions
decisive_items: diffuse large B-cell lymphoma diagnosed 4 years ago
diffuse medium masses in the right atrium
significantly increased metabolic activity along the right atrial myocardium and adjacent pericardium
response.rationale: The patient's history of lymphoma and current presentation of masses in the right atrium and increased metabolic activity suggest cardiac involvement of lymphoma, making R3 the strongest candidate. C1 is a close runner-up as it provides more specific localization of the lymphoma to the right atrium, but it is an append-only completion of R3.

rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence linking chemotherapy to cardiomyopathy in this patient
Electrocardiogram abnormalities and symptoms are not specific to cardiac amyloidosis and can be explained by lymphoma involvement
